name: case
description: Module 26, capstones 2 and 4: an application that reaches https://api/health through a stub resolver, a caching resolver, an authoritative server and nginx — healthy, then each instructor fault with its symptom, a discriminating observation and the repair

files./etc/resolv.conf:
nameserver 198.18.240.53
search shop.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2

files./etc/unbound/unbound.conf:
server:
	interface: 198.18.240.53
	interface: 127.0.0.1
	port: 53
	do-ip6: no
	username: ""
	chroot: ""
	directory: "/etc/unbound"
	pidfile: ""
	use-syslog: no
	logfile: ""
	verbosity: 1
	log-queries: yes
	access-control: 0.0.0.0/0 refuse
	access-control: 127.0.0.0/8 allow
	access-control: 198.18.240.0/24 allow
	# no internet here: everything outside test. is answered NXDOMAIN locally
	local-zone: "." static
	# test. is reserved (RFC 6761); transparent overrides both unbound's built-in
	# NXDOMAIN for it and the static "." above, so test. is resolved via the stub
	local-zone: "test." transparent
	prefetch: no
	serve-expired: no
stub-zone:
	name: "test."
	stub-addr: 198.18.240.2
remote-control:
	control-enable: yes
	control-interface: 127.0.0.1
	control-use-cert: no

server:
	interface: 198.18.240.54
	interface: 127.0.0.1
	port: 53
	do-ip6: no
	username: ""
	chroot: ""
	directory: "/etc/unbound"
	pidfile: ""
	use-syslog: no
	logfile: ""
	verbosity: 1
	log-queries: yes
	access-control: 0.0.0.0/0 refuse
	access-control: 127.0.0.0/8 allow
	access-control: 198.18.240.0/24 allow
	# no internet here: everything outside test. is answered NXDOMAIN locally
	local-zone: "." static
	# test. is reserved (RFC 6761); transparent overrides both unbound's built-in
	# NXDOMAIN for it and the static "." above, so test. is resolved via the stub
	local-zone: "test." transparent
	prefetch: no
	serve-expired: no
stub-zone:
	name: "test."
	stub-addr: 198.18.240.3
remote-control:
	control-enable: yes
	control-interface: 127.0.0.1
	control-use-cert: no

nodes.name: web

checks.name: healthy baseline: the application resolves api through the search list (api.shop.test), connects, verifies the chain against its CA bundle and gets 200 — this also puts api.shop.test in the resolver's cache
run: echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- what the resolver holds:'; dig +noall +answer @198.18.240.53 api.shop.test

checks.name: dns 'resolver': the host's nameserver is an address where nothing answers — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run:
echo '=== fault injected'; printf 'nameserver 198.18.240.99
search shop.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2
' > /etc/resolv.conf; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; echo "dig via the configured server: $(dig +tries=1 +time=2 api.shop.test 2>&1 | grep -o 'timed out' | head -1)"; echo "dig @198.18.240.53 (the resolver the other hosts use): $(dig +short @198.18.240.53 api.shop.test)"; echo '=== repaired'; printf 'nameserver 198.18.240.53
search shop.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2
' > /etc/resolv.conf; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json
expect_contains: i/o timeout [no answer from the nameserver(s)]
dig @198.18.240.53 (the resolver the other hosts use): 198.18.240.20

checks.name: dns 'search': the search list was changed to other.test, so the short name becomes api.other.test (and api.) — both NXDOMAIN — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run:
echo '=== fault injected'; printf 'nameserver 198.18.240.53
search other.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2
' > /etc/resolv.conf; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; for n in api.other.test api. api.shop.test; do echo "$n: $(dig @198.18.240.53 $n | grep -o 'status: [A-Z]*')"; done; a=$(dig +search +short api); echo "dig +search api: ${a:-(no answer)}"; echo '=== repaired'; printf 'nameserver 198.18.240.53
search shop.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2
' > /etc/resolv.conf; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json
expect_contains: no such host [the name does not exist

checks.name: dns 'view': the host was pointed at the public resolver, whose authority publishes the external address — DNS 'works', the address is unreachable from inside — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run:
echo '=== fault injected'; printf 'nameserver 198.18.240.54
search shop.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2
' > /etc/resolv.conf; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; echo "internal resolver: $(dig +short @198.18.240.53 api.shop.test)   public resolver: $(dig +short @198.18.240.54 api.shop.test)"; echo "authorities: $(dig +short +norec @198.18.240.2 api.shop.test) vs $(dig +short +norec @198.18.240.3 api.shop.test)"; echo '=== repaired'; printf 'nameserver 198.18.240.53
search shop.test
options timeout:2 attempts:2
' > /etc/resolv.conf; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json

checks.name: dns 'cache': api moved to .21 (the authority changed, the old address no longer serves) but the resolver still holds the old answer for the rest of its 300 s TTL — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run: echo '=== fault injected'; ip netns exec nl-case-auth sed -i 's/^api.shop\t300\tA\t.*/api.shop\t300\tA\t198.18.240.21/' /etc/bind/test.db && ip netns exec nl-case-auth rndc -s 127.0.0.1 -k /etc/bind/rndc.key reload test >/dev/null; sed -i 's/listen 198.18.240.20:443/listen 198.18.240.21:443/' ${EVIDENCE}/web/site.conf && ip netns exec nl-case-web nginx -c ${EVIDENCE}/web/nginx.conf -s reload 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; echo "authority: $(dig +noall +answer +norec @198.18.240.2 api.shop.test)"; echo "resolver:  $(dig +noall +answer @198.18.240.53 api.shop.test)"; sleep 2; echo "resolver, 2 s later: $(dig +noall +answer @198.18.240.53 api.shop.test)"; echo '=== repaired'; ip netns exec nl-case-resolver unbound-control flush api.shop.test >/dev/null; echo "resolver after flush: $(dig +short @198.18.240.53 api.shop.test)"; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json

checks.name: put the address back (zone, nginx, cache) for the TLS cases
run: ip netns exec nl-case-auth sed -i 's/^api.shop\t300\tA\t.*/api.shop\t300\tA\t198.18.240.20/' /etc/bind/test.db && ip netns exec nl-case-auth rndc -s 127.0.0.1 -k /etc/bind/rndc.key reload test >/dev/null; sed -i 's/listen 198.18.240.21:443/listen 198.18.240.20:443/' ${EVIDENCE}/web/site.conf && ip netns exec nl-case-web nginx -c ${EVIDENCE}/web/nginx.conf -s reload 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; ip netns exec nl-case-resolver unbound-control flush api.shop.test >/dev/null; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json

checks.name: tls 'chain': nginx was changed to send only the leaf, not leaf + intermediate — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run: echo '=== fault injected'; sed -i 's|api-chain.pem|api.pem|' ${EVIDENCE}/web/site.conf && ip netns exec nl-case-web nginx -c ${EVIDENCE}/web/nginx.conf -s reload 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; echo "certificates sent: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts  </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -c 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE')"; echo "openssl with the lab root: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts -CAfile ${EVIDENCE}/pki/root.pem </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -m1 -o 'Verify return code: .*')"; echo '=== repaired'; sed -i 's|api.pem|api-chain.pem|' ${EVIDENCE}/web/site.conf && ip netns exec nl-case-web nginx -c ${EVIDENCE}/web/nginx.conf -s reload 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo "certificates sent: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts  </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -c 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE')"; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json
expect_contains: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
Verify return code: 21 (unable to verify the first certificate)

checks.name: tls 'trust': the application's CA bundle was replaced with a corporate inspection CA — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run: echo '=== fault injected'; cp ${EVIDENCE}/pki/inspection-ca.pem ${EVIDENCE}/app/ca-bundle.pem; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; echo "certificates sent: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts  </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -c 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE'), issuer of the top one: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts  </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -m2 ' i:' | tail -1)"; echo "the app trusts: $(openssl x509 -in ${EVIDENCE}/app/ca-bundle.pem -noout -subject)"; echo "openssl with the app's bundle: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts -CAfile ${EVIDENCE}/app/ca-bundle.pem </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -m1 -o 'Verify return code: .*')"; echo '=== repaired'; cp ${EVIDENCE}/pki/root.pem ${EVIDENCE}/app/ca-bundle.pem; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json
expect_contains: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
certificates sent: 2, issuer of the top one:
Verify return code: 20 (unable to get local issuer certificate)

checks.name: tls 'hostname': nginx was changed to send another service's certificate — inject, see the symptom, make the discriminating observation, repair, re-run the application
run: echo '=== fault injected'; sed -i 's|api-chain.pem|other-chain.pem|; s|api.key|other.key|' ${EVIDENCE}/web/site.conf && ip netns exec nl-case-web nginx -c ${EVIDENCE}/web/nginx.conf -s reload 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json; echo '--- discriminating observation:'; openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts  </dev/null 2>&1 | openssl x509 -noout -subject -ext subjectAltName | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "openssl checking the name: $(openssl s_client -connect 198.18.240.20:443 -servername api -showcerts -CAfile ${EVIDENCE}/pki/root.pem -verify_hostname api </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -m1 -o 'Verify return code: .*')"; echo '=== repaired'; sed -i 's|other-chain.pem|api-chain.pem|; s|other.key|api.key|' ${EVIDENCE}/web/site.conf && ip netns exec nl-case-web nginx -c ${EVIDENCE}/web/nginx.conf -s reload 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo '--- the application:'; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json
expect_contains: x509: certificate is valid for other.test, not api

checks.name: after every repair verification is still on: a client using a name the certificate does not carry (www.shop.test, same server) is rejected, and so is one trusting only an unrelated root
run: sed 's|https://api/health|https://www.shop.test/health|' ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json > ${EVIDENCE}/app/wrong-name.json; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/wrong-name.json | grep -E '^tls|RESULT'; sed 's|ca-bundle.pem|../pki/rogue-root.pem|' ${EVIDENCE}/app/config.json > ${EVIDENCE}/app/wrong-ca.json; ${BIN}/caselab probe -config ${EVIDENCE}/app/wrong-ca.json | grep -E '^tls|RESULT'; true
